package violations

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

// Remove ignores the error from os.Remove.
func Remove() {
	os.Remove("fixture") // want: errcheck, gosec
}

// Locked receives its mutex by value, so locking it protects nothing.
func Locked(mu sync.Mutex) int { // want: govet
	mu.Lock()
	n := 1
	mu.Unlock()
	return n
}

// Overwritten assigns a value that is never read.
func Overwritten() int {
	n := 1 // want: ineffassign
	n = 2
	return n
}

// Title calls a deprecated function.
func Title(s string) string {
	return strings.Title(s) // want: staticcheck
}

func unusedHelper() {} // want: unused
